added.name: Shire Intelligence
added.long_description: Shire is an AI floor manager for full-service restaurants, running on the cameras they already have. It sees what a great manager sees: a guest ready to order, a table waiting on the check, a four-top that needs clearing, a server that is double booked. Then it acts, alerting staff in the moment and seating each new party with the server who has room. A POS only knows what gets typed into it. Shire knows what is happening in the room, so wait-time quotes, staffing, and pricing run on real turn times.
added.one_liner: Shire uses CCTV to run restaurants in real time.

added.name: GrayPass
added.long_description:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass verifies the expected person is still in control before consequential actions happen. We use cognitive biometrics like typing rhythm, cursor movement, scrolling, and response timing alongside session and device context to continuously establish assurance.

Before actions like approving a payment, changing admin permissions, exporting sensitive data, or letting an AI agent act on someone’s behalf, GrayPass returns allow, challenge, hold, or deny and produces signed proof tied to that action.
added.one_liner: Verify that the expected person is in control before key actions.

long_description.before:
Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 150k+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves - no hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.

long_description.before: Diffusion Studio lets your agents make videos. The agent writes a composition in TSX and mounts it into the editor. Every element stays editable. Think of it as FFmpeg for agents, with generative AI and multimodal understanding built in.

Custom AI models are going to win. Belvedir is the infrastructure needed to make trillions of them.

long_description.before:
The next constraint is not intelligence, it is the energy cost of running it.
We deploy custom AI models inside energy companies that ingest SCADA data, work orders, and grid topology,  operational data no public model has seen, grounded in physics-informed neural networks and differentiable grid simulators. 
This creates a flywheel: more operator data → better process understanding → more efficient operations → cheaper energy → cheaper AI → more deployment → more data. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uDH6pMn5OE

AI compute doubles every 2.2 years. Data center demand grows from 415 to 945 TWh by 2030. Without near-zero energy cost, AI remains limited by human infrastructure. We are the layer that runs AI at zero energy cost.
Energy is a $10 trillion market. The infrastructure layer doesn't exist yet. 
We are building it.
